about: Canon ground works after 1912. Everything the compositor needs is in this file: each work's years (built_from, built_by; null = undated), its timeline (canon, real or both), and its 'apply' block: kind target_mode (target and mode rasters, optionally one part of a shared raster), map3_footprint (the 2026 canon ground inside a raster's non-zero cells), map3_zones (the 2026 canon ground inside polygons, each zone with its own years in a years file), raster (a surface that replaces the ground), model (generated from the hub model), none. Order of application is the order of this list. Change a date, a file or a kind here and every composed year follows; the code holds no dates, layers or geometry.
conflicts: Embankment dates: the 7 October 2026 relief plan, citing tracker 2J, gives the Embankment 1925-1930 and keeps it off map 2. Ben ruled on 8 October 2026 (Relief_Maps_Log 10d) that the Embankment is 1903-1925 and that map 2 gets the Mill Creek mouth to Sawyer Point stretch. This ledger uses the 8 October ruling. The tracker needs updating.

Mill Creek deck dates: the 7 October plan (tracker 2J) has the deck after 1933; Ben ruled on 6 November 2026 that the full decking from Albone to the Ohio is done by 1913. The ledger follows the 6 November ruling; the tracker needs updating.

works.name: Ohio Embankment, Mill Creek mouth to Sawyer Point (5.28 km), and the lower Mill Creek culvert (mouth to about Harrison Ave)
works.note: Culvert 1903-1908. The Embankment stretch is complete by 1912 (map 2).

works.note: Phase dates within 1912-1925 not ruled. Shares the 2026 riverworks raster with the deck and Lunken. Part 1 of riverworks_2026_part.tif.

works.name: Mill Creek deck, 151.8 m at the Embankment rising to 160 m at Camp Washington north, yards cut 8.5 m below it
works.note: Ben, 6 November 2026: the full decking from Albone to the Ohio River is done by 1913. (The 7 October plan, citing tracker 2J, had it after 1933.) Its own part of the shared 2026 riverworks raster (riverworks_2026_part.tif = 2).

works.name: Lunken levee ring raised to 83 ft (155.8 m); new levee along the Little Miami east bank

works.name: Lunken airfield lifted 1 m on Metro spoil (1.9 km2)
